title: Manga 'Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito' Gets TV Anime
content: A television anime adaptation of Sekina Aoi and Ryou Tsuzura 's Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito ( My Crush's Crush ) manga was announced on Friday. Tsuzura drew an illustration to commemorate the announcement (pictured above).
author: MyAnimeList

title: My Crush's Crush Manga Gets TV Anime
content: Writer Sekina Aoi and artist Ryō Tsuzura 's My Crush’s Crush ( Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito ) manga is getting a television anime adaptation. Tsuzura shared an illustration to commemorate the announcement: When Sora Akizuki confesses his feelings to Miya Fuwa, he gets rejected outright.
author: ANN

title: Whisper of the Heart UK Cinema Release Details Confirmed
content: In a press release on Thursday, GKIDS has confirmed UK cinema release details for Studio Ghibli 's 1995 film Whisper of the Heart , directed by Yoshifumi Kondō , in mid-September. The 4K remastered film will appear on IMAX screens from Wednesday September 16, with a wider cinema release from Friday September 18.
author: ANN

title: The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE -Yotsuba Succession Arc- Will Be Released in UK Cinemas on November 4 and 5
content: Crunchyroll announced in a press release on Wednesday that it and Sony Pictures Entertainment will release The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE - Yotsuba Succession Arc - ( Mahōka Kōkō no Rettōsei: Yotsuba Keishō-hen ) anime film in UK cinemas on November 4 and 5, in Japanese with subttles..
author: ANN

title: Gamers! Creator Sekina Aoi's My Crush's Crush Manga Gets TV Anime
content: Sekina Aoi’s My Crush’s Crush (Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito) manga is officially getting a TV anime adaptation. An announcement illustration by manga artist Ryo Tsuzura was released along with the news. Sekina Aoi is also known as the creator of the Gamers! manga.
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga UP! Global Adds The Viscount's Porky Portrait: I Married the Knight My Sister Rejected Manga in English
content: Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service adds Akina 's The Viscount's Porky Portrait: I Married the Knight My Sister Rejected ( Bijin no Ane ga Iyagatta node, Dōmitemo Sugatae ga Shirobuta no Jiki Hakushaku ni Totsugimashita Tokoro ) manga, the adaptation of Mogura Manami 's light novels of the same title, on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Maebashi Witches Compilation Film Streams Main Trailer
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed the main trailer and key visual for Gekijōban Maebashi Witches: Majo Minarai no Emoemories (Maebashi Witches Emoemories: Blooming Witches), the compilation film for the Maebashi Witches original television anime , on Friday.
author: ANN

title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 Anime Unveils Promo Video, Visual, October 1 Premiere on Netflix
content: The official website for the television anime of Kōcha Agasawa 's The Ramparts of Ice ( Koori no Jyōheki or Ice Castle Wall ) manga unveiled on Thursday a promotional video, visual, and October 1 premiere on Netflix for the second season .
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Studio’s Hottest Upcoming Series Goes on Unexpected Hiatus Ahead of Debut
content: The studio behind Jujutsu Kaisen , MAPPA, has several exciting projects coming up in 2027 and beyond, including sequels and new series. Established in 2011, it didn’t take long for the studio to become one of the most renowned studios in the industry.
author: ComicBook
